watch.readinessNote: One Steam build id covers both platforms (shared content depot 232250, Linux depot 232256, Windows depot 232255). The connector is a SourceMod plugin that uses game events and SDK calls by name, not code addresses, so a new TF2 build usually keeps working; a new build can still break MetaMod:Source or SourceMod, and every build needs a live retest before it is declared.

plugin.description: The SourceMod plugin takaro_tf2.smx with the two ProjectSky extensions it needs (websocket, json) and its config template, unpacked into the server's tf/ folder. It holds the Takaro connection itself; no sidecar
